   Bytes Format Units      Label          Explanations
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   1- 23 A23    ---        Site           Hot Spot
  25- 28 I4     yr         Obs.Y          UT Observation Date, Year
  30- 32 A3     ---        Obs.M          UT Observation Date, Month
  34- 35 I2     d          Obs.D          UT Observation Date, Day in Month
  37- 41 F5.1   deg        LAT            Latitude, degrees North
  43- 45 F3.1   deg      e_LAT            Uncertainty in LAT
  47- 51 F5.1   deg        LON            Longitude, degrees West
  53- 56 F4.1   deg      e_LON            Uncertainty in LON
  58- 62 F5.1   GW/um/sr   I-Kc           ?="" Continuum intensity in Kc filter (2.27um) (1)
  64- 68 F5.1   GW/um/sr e_I-Kc           ?="" Uncertainty in I-Kc
